answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 30205 Country: India Title: Can I marry my fathers step sisters granddaughter(the girl is my cousin sisters daughter)? my fathers step sister means their father is one but mothers are different. Question: can i marry my fathers step sisters granddaughter(the girl is my cousin sisters daughter)? my fathers step sister means their father is one but mothers are different. Answer ID: 30205 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 416/416/M=1432) If there is no hindrance that invalidates nikah like fosterage etc, you can marry the granddaughter of your father's stepsister. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
